subject.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner

question: Must this exact PR produce authenticated read and plan plus full runtime and teardown proof in the dedicated FakeCo account before merge, or may the feature owner explicitly waive that gate?
rationale: The account-specific infrastructure cannot be fully validated from fixtures, and the PR itself declares live AWS proof to be a merge gate; accepting an unexecuted owner requires explicit human ownership of that risk.

options.title: Require live AWS proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted authenticated preflight, plan, apply, verify, backup and restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown evidence is attached.

options.title: Grant an item-specific waiver
options.body: Explicitly accept this exact commit without live execution and own the first-run operational risk after merge.

recommendation.title: Require live AWS proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted authenticated preflight, plan, apply, verify, backup and restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and most heavily owns the existing FakeCo staging surface and is best positioned to resolve its account-specific proof gate.
